description: Stable short hash of parameters.toml's contents, stamped onto every games_enriched and analysis_results row so a derived score can be traced back to the exact constants that produced it (ADR-009).
docstring:
Compute a stable content hash for the parameter file.

Args:
    path: Absolute path to config/parameters.toml.

Returns:
    A short (first 12 hex characters), deterministic sha256 hash of the file's raw bytes. Using raw bytes rather than a re-serialization of the parsed dict means the hash also changes on a whitespace-only or comment-only edit, which is the more conservative (safer to over-invalidate than to silently under-invalidate) choice given that params_version exists purely for traceability, not for change deduplication.

Raises:
    ParameterError: If path does not exist or is not readable.
preconditions: path points to a file, not a directory
postconditions: Calling parameters_version twice on the same unmodified file returns the identical string
Any byte-level change to the file changes the returned string

edge_cases.input: the file is re-saved with identical content but a different mtime/encoding-of-newlines
edge_cases.expected_behavior: hash is unchanged if and only if the bytes are identical; a CRLF/LF conversion does change the hash, which is intentional -- version stamping is byte-exact, not semantic

unit_tests.name: test_stable_across_repeated_reads
unit_tests.description: Two calls on the same file return the same string.

unit_tests.name: test_changes_when_a_value_changes
unit_tests.description: Copies the fixture, edits one numeric value, and re-hashes.
unit_tests.expected: different string from the original fixture's hash
